RagShortTexts: The Rurikid dynasty preserved Rus princely bloodlines across fragmented principalities.

Variants.Content: Tracing descent from Rurik the Varangian, the Rurikid dynasty held all Rus lands under the falcon trident tamga emblem. Following the 1240 Mongol conquest, the dynasty fractured: Alexander Nevsky in Vladimir practiced stoic submission to the Golden Horde to shield Orthodox churches, while Daniel of Galicia accepted a papal crown to wage war against the Tatars.
Khanate patents (yarlyks) settled succession disputes. Rurikid cousins journeyed across frozen steppes to Sarai with chests of sable furs, bidding for supremacy before the Golden Horde.
The Orthodox Metropolitan of Kyiv, residing across northern towns, preserved ecclesiastical unity, counseling princes against fratricidal squabbling.
